about: Hi, I'm Jake. I'm a robotics engineer for my day job, and I've dabbled in blogging and geopolitical forecasting. I recently spent a year unsuccessfully attempting to start my own business, and I plan to try again before long! I agree with most of the ideas behind the effective altruism movement and am trying to spend my life doing as much good as I can for the world.

I currently run a history book club and a classics book club in Arlington/DC, and other hobbies include: drawing, improv, memorization, and writing. If you're interested in my work or there's something I can help with, please reach out!
